notes: Replaces the failing separate multi-cover batch editor with a queue that uses The Library's existing regular Split Full Cover screen. Multiple File Explorer drops are kept together, the first cover opens in the normal splitter, Previous/Next lets you move through the dropped covers, and each cover keeps its own guide positions and metadata while you navigate. Saving a cover creates only Back Cover, Spine, and Front Cover, removes that item from the queue, and automatically loads the next one. This bypasses the batch-panel code responsible for the repeated null-valued-expression failure. Windows validation passed with six simultaneous covers, navigation/state preservation, live WinForms processing, and all 18 expected split images/records saved.
